name: Jan - Mar 2026 sell-off
description: Replay of the 2026 Nifty 50 drawdown, most of which happened in March 2026.
rationale: Peak-to-trough of Nifty 50 closes in 2026 in our cache: 26,328.55 on 2026-01-02 to 22,331.40 on 2026-03-30 (-15.18%), 57 sessions. Most of the fall came in March: from 25,178.65 on 2026-02-27 to the trough is -11.31%. Peak to trough was chosen for consistency with the other drawdown windows.
caveats: Cause: verify. It is not documented here; check a market commentary source before attributing one.
The gold fund's -9.9% day on 2026-02-02 falls inside the window; it was verified against HDFC Gold ETF FoF (-10.8%) and SBI Gold (-8.5%), see 'Gold FoF check' in docs/data.md.
